- SessionStart injector systemMessage: `-----\n🎯 Compact goal\n\n<goal>\n\nStatus: <status>\n-----` only for the three recognized values from a Status: line inside `## Last request`; else goal alone as before; additionalContext unchanged
- Correct only if:
  - prompt section order/wording does not break existing goal extraction or the facts-block reference

  - tests go red on real regressions
- Finding nothing is a valid answer
